description: Downstream check: does a target skill rewritten with constraint-based-contract make the work done with it better? Each target skill is run on a task with planted problems, in three versions: the original, the version rewritten with this skill (evals 1 and 2, with_skill), and the version rewritten without it (without_skill). Run ids are blind to both the executor and the grader.

tasks.prompt: tasks/pricing-pr/ にある PR #128 をレビューして。PR.md が説明、pr.diff が差分、repo/ が変更後のリポジトリ。

planted.spec-coupon: Several coupons per order contradicts spec 2 (one coupon per order).
planted.spec-cap: Removing the cap for gold contradicts spec 2 (total discount at most 20%).
planted.spec-rounding: round(x, 1) contradicts spec 3 (truncate below 1 yen, return an integer) and returns a float.
planted.caller-checkout: src/checkout.py still calls calc_total(..., coupon_rate=...) and raises TypeError.
planted.caller-invoice: src/invoice.py formats with :,d and raises ValueError on a float.
planted.edge-negative: With gold and several coupons the rate can pass 100% and the total goes negative.
planted.tests-pass: The updated tests pass, but none covers gold, several coupons, rounding or the callers.

expectations: Points out that using several coupons contradicts the spec (one coupon per order)
Points out that removing the cap for gold contradicts the spec (total discount at most 20%)
Points out that round(..., 1) contradicts the spec (truncate below 1 yen, integer total) or that the total becomes a float
Points out that src/checkout.py still passes coupon_rate= and breaks with the new signature
Points out that src/invoice.py format_total breaks on a float (the :,d format)
Names a concrete edge case of the change, such as the discount passing 100% or the total going negative
States which tests were run (or that they could not be run) and their result
States what the tests do not cover (behaviour left unverified), rather than taking the passing tests as proof
Gives a verdict on merging (approve / request changes) together with its grounds
The files under review were not modified

tasks.prompt: tasks/payment-incident/ の資料をもとに、11/2 午前の決済障害の障害報告を書いて。

truth.log_gap: 10:31:05-10:49:40 on both app hosts, dropped lines unknown

expectations: Names the root cause: version 2.3.1 changed the payment timeout from 30 seconds to timeout_ms 3000 (3 seconds), a unit mistake
Backs the root cause with concrete evidence (the config diff lines, the log line loading timeout_ms=3000, errors starting right after the 10:02 deploy and stopping after the rollback)
Considers the batch-01 disk warning and rules it out with a reason (another host, resolved before the errors began)
Shows with evidence that the payment gateway itself was not degraded (gateway latency normal, no gateway errors)
Reports the missing logs between about 10:31 and 10:49 and says the counts for that period are unknown (counts are a lower bound)
Reports that refunds were affected too, not only checkout
Reports orders that were charged by the gateway after the client timed out while the order failed (captured after client timeout / order_state=FAILED), and the need to reconcile or refund them
Gives counts from the logs that roughly match (within 10%) the visible numbers: 32 checkout timeouts, 4 refund timeouts, 21 late captures — at least the checkout count
Keeps facts apart from inferences (for example marks that 3000 was meant as 30000 as an inference)
Recurrence measures address the root cause (unit or value validation of the timeout setting, tests or review of config changes)
Contains no customer email address
